P7525.corridor_notes: This is the '枞阳合建站-枞阳县城天然气高压管线' project: a short high-pressure connector linking the long-distance trunk handover point (枞阳合建站, 'Zongyang co-built/joint station' -- terminology for a station jointly built between the provincial gas company and the long-distance trunk line) to a new gate station (桥港园门站) sited at the Chery Automotive Parts Industrial Park (奇瑞汽车零部件产业园) within the Qiaogang Garden (桥港园) development, southeast Zongyang County town. Zongyang.gov.cn's siting notice for the gate station explicitly states the pipeline 'connects long-distance high-pressure and urban medium-pressure systems' and is 'a key node project for Zongyang County to achieve pipeline natural gas service.' Zongyang Hejian Station's exact site was not directly located; two ahtrq.com (Anhui Natural Gas Development Co.) notices place river-crossing/valve-chamber inspection activity for the related 会宫-枞阳 (Huigong-Zongyang) trunk feeder and the 合建站 itself in the vicinity of 藕山镇, 会宫镇, and especially 官埠桥镇 (site of a 'Guanbu Bridge valve chamber' explicitly tied to the 合建站 inspection route) -- 官埠桥镇 sits between 会宫镇 (the feeder line's origin) and Zongyang's county town, making it the most defensible township-level anchor for the co-built station pending a precise address.
P7525.researcher_notes: GEM's own StartLocation='Zongyang Hejian Station' / EndLocation='Qiaogang Industrial Park' match what was found; the end point is well-corroborated at station-level precision (zongyang.gov.cn's planning-notice public disclosure gives the exact siting description). The start point (Zongyang Hejian Station itself) could only be pinned to township level (官埠桥镇) via two independent ahtrq.com notices that place river-crossing/valve-chamber work tied to the station in that town -- neither gives street-level coordinates or a formal address. LengthMergedKm=7.10km for this row is short and plausible for a co-built-station-to-town-gate-station connector at this scale. No indication this row duplicates any other GEM entry.
P7525.blockers: Zongyang Hejian Station's precise site (as opposed to the general 官埠桥镇 township area) was not located in this pass; a human drawing the route should treat the start coordinate as a loose township-level anchor, not a station pin. P7526.corridor_notes: This is the '环巢湖天然气高压管线工程' (Huanchaohu / 'ring Chaohu Lake' high-pressure gas pipeline), which GEM's own ResearcherNotes (citing hefei.gov.cn) already describes as two sections: (1) the Hefei-Chaohu section ('He-Chao Line' / 合巢线): Feidong County Dianpu Gas Transmission Station (north shore, connecting to CNOOC's Binhai LNG peak-shaving pipeline) -> Huashan Gas Transmission Station in Anchao Economic Development Zone (east shore, Chaohu City) -- confirmed independently via sina.com.cn and bjx.com.cn coverage of its commissioning on 2026-03-13, ~76km, RMB 6.5 billion investment, annual capacity 10.1 bcm, described as 'a key node' of Anhui's 'three vertical, four horizontal, one ring' provincial trunk network; and (2) the Lujiang-Chaohu section ('Lu-Chao Line'), which appears to correspond to this batch's P7527 (Lubei Gate Station -> Huashan Gas Transmission Station, 119.00km, already tracked as its own operating GEM row -- see duplicate/overlap flag in blockers). Both sections converge on the same Huashan Gas Transmission Station, forming two spokes (north via Feidong/Dianpu, and southwest via Lujiang/Yanqiao) that together loop around the eastern and southern shore of Chaohu Lake -- consistent with the 'ring Chaohu' (环巢湖) name, though it is a two-spoke convergence at Huashan rather than a literal closed loop. This PID's own LengthMergedKm (189.00km) is close to the sum of the two documented sections (~76km He-Chao + ~119km Lu-Chao =~195km, plausibly reconciled by a few km of shared alignment or rounding near Huashan).
P7526.researcher_notes: Endpoints given here (Dianpu -> Huashan) are the He-Chao section specifically, since that is the sub-project with a clear, well-sourced, and currently-relevant (just commissioned March 2026) start/end; per the task's ring-topology instruction these are offered as the 'best two anchor points' for the whole named project even though P7526's full scope (per its own ResearcherNotes) spans both sections. GEM's row for this PID shows Status='construction' with no StartLocation/EndLocation on file, while the He-Chao section's own commissioning coverage says it went into service 2026-03-13 -- i.e. GEM's 'construction' status for this row may be stale relative to the He-Chao section, though could still be accurate if the row is meant to track the Lu-Chao section's completion or the project bundle as a whole.
P7526.blockers: STRUCTURAL OVERLAP FLAG (recommend human adjudication, not resolved here): P7526's own two-section description names a 'Lujiang-Chaohu section (Lu-Chao Line)' that closely matches this batch's P7527 (Lujiang-Chaohu Gas Pipeline, Lubei Gate Station -> Huashan Gas Transmission Station, 119.00km, operating) in name, endpoints, and length -- but P7526 (189km total, construction status) is NOT an exact duplicate of P7527 alone, since it also covers the He-Chao section that has no separate PID in this batch. The hefei.gov.cn source cited in GEM's pre-existing ResearcherNotes (https://www.hefei.gov.cn/bmts/110159599.html) returned HTTP 403 on this pass and has no Wayback snapshot -- could not be independently re-verified, so this pass relies on the sina.com.cn / bjx.com.cn commissioning coverage instead.

P7527.corridor_notes: GEM's SegmentName ('Zongyang Hejian Station...' -- no, corrected: SegmentName is 'Lujiang-Chaohu Gas Pipeline', zh_segment '庐北—严桥输气管道') and StartLocation/EndLocation ('Lubei'/'Huashan') are corroborated by a verified primary tender document (ah.zhiliaobiaoxun.com) for '环巢湖天然气高压管线工程庐江-巢湖段（严桥-花山）管道安装工程-2标段' -- i.e. this pipeline is explicitly one of the two named sections of the broader 环巢湖 (Huanchaohu) project also covered by this batch's P7526 (see that PID's blockers for the overlap flag). The tender document's own project-level route detail: DN700 pipe, 6.3MPa design pressure, total length ~119.038km (matches GEM's LengthMergedKm=119.00 almost exactly), annual capacity 12.981 bcm. The specific construction section (标段2) documented in the tender runs 银屏镇 (Yinping Town, Chaohu City) -> 安巢经开区 (Anchao Economic Development Zone, Chaohu City), passing through 含山县 林头镇 and 清溪镇 (Lintou and Qingxi towns, Hanshan County, Ma'anshan) and crossing the 裕溪河/清溪河/汤河 waterways -- i.e. this is the eastern/final leg of the full Lubei-to-Huashan alignment, not the whole route. The pipeline's westward continuation from 严桥 (Yanqiao town, Wuwei City -- geocoded separately for P7528) back to 庐北 (Lubei, Lujiang County) was not independently re-verified at station level in this pass (see blockers) but is consistent with GEM's own field data and a broader secondary-source picture of the line crossing Lujiang, Wuwei, and Hanshan counties en route from Lujiang to Chaohu.
P7527.researcher_notes: Operating status and ~119km length are both well-corroborated. Endpoint place-name resolution is asymmetric: the Huashan/Anchao end is solidly sourced at industrial-park level from the same primary tender document that names the whole project; the Lubei/Lujiang end is only pinned to the county-seat town (庐城镇) since no source in this pass named a specific station address for 'Lubei' -- it reads as a directional descriptor ('north Lujiang [gate station]') rather than a place name Nominatim can resolve directly. Yanqiao (严桥镇), which appears in this pipeline's segment name ('庐北—严桥输气管道') and independently geocodes to a real town in Wuwei City (31.4058546, 117.7238440) -- NOT Lujiang County as might be assumed from the pipeline's naming -- is treated here as a waypoint the trunk line passes through en route to Huashan, and as the western terminus of the separate, shorter P7528 (Chaohu-Wuwei) lateral that branches off at Yanqiao toward Wucheng. This Yanqiao/Wuwei-crossing detail reconciles P7527's and P7528's otherwise-confusing overlapping place names.
